name: Siegfried Mureşan - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: Draft amending budget 4/2024: update of revenue (own resources) and adjustments to some decentralised agencies
part_text:
The European Parliament approves changes to the European Union's 2024 budget. The changes update where the money comes from: customs duties came in lower than expected, and the United Kingdom's exit payment is 1.52 billion euros lower. To make up the gap, member states' contributions based on national income rise by 5.63 billion euros. The changes also adjust funding for several European Union agencies, adding 12 million euros in total. Parliament also calls for better forecasting and for new sources of money for the budget.

- Money: national income contributions rise by 5.63 billion euros; agency funding rises by 12 million euros.
- Affected: European Union member states, the United Kingdom, and several European Union agencies.
- Next: the budget change is adopted and published in the Official Journal.
